title: An abort retry's boot recovery after a restart runs outside the host-wide automatic-retry cap
outcome: An abort retry's boot recovery after a restart runs outside the host-wide automatic-retry cap
acceptance: An abort-retry head's boot recovery after a restart holds a host-wide retry slot (eager pass and lazy recovery alike), or defers to its own due attempt when the cap is full; a test with more than K restarted abort-retry heads shows at most K recoveries in flight.
